p1_findings.finding: Worst setup slack is 0.0000 ns and all 100 reported setup paths lie within 0.0044 ns. QoR reports 70 logic levels, while timing uses ZeroWireload, an ideal clock and no CTS/placement/extracted RC. The postcompile clock net has 4509 loads and TIM-134 substitutes fanout 1000 for delay computation.
p1_findings.impact: This meets only the frozen DC pass gate; it is not evidence of physical 3 ns closure. Any realistic macro access, route or clock effect can consume the entire margin.
p1_findings.required_action: Run macro feasibility first, then PrimeTime with explicit conservative macro input/output delays, clock/route envelope or extracted parasitics. A negative slack rejects the fused timing assumption; do not relax the clock or add an issue bubble silently.

p1_findings.finding: The phrase '144-byte scratch' is the word width, not total capacity: 96x12=1152 bits=144 B per word and ROW_BITS=6 gives 64 words, hence 9 KiB total. The resident psum interface is 96x19=1824 bits=228 B per word and is 14.25 KiB if provisioned for the same 64 rows.
p1_findings.impact: Macro count and macro area are zero in M475. Wide 1R1W banking, muxing, address decode, tCQ/setup and energy can dominate the currently excluded feasibility/PPA envelope.
p1_findings.required_action: Freeze an explicit 64x1152-bit scratch banking topology and, if 64-row resident psum is intended, a 64x1824-bit topology. Report word width and total KiB separately and feed real or conservative macro timing/load back into PrimeTime.

p1_findings.finding: DC emits four VER-318 signed-to-unsigned part-selection warnings at RTL lines 102, 104, 220 and 221. These are final/prefix truncation points covered by the functional contract but remain synthesis semantic risk until LEC.
p1_findings.impact: Directed VCS and width bounds do not substitute for RTL-to-gate equivalence across all states and signed values.
p1_findings.required_action: Run exact-SHA Formality using the sealed SVF/netlist. Any non-equivalent compare point is a hard stop.

p1_findings.finding: The 37316.285232 um2 result is standard-cell area only; total area is undefined because net area is zero, and both memories are external cuts. The worst setup endpoint is scratch_reads_q_reg[21], one of the debug counters, although near-critical parent_data paths are also present.
p1_findings.impact: The number is neither physical PPA nor a clean production-datapath-only area. Removing instrumentation would create a new RTL identity and require the functional/formal gates to be rerun.
p1_findings.required_action: Keep the current number labeled instrumented logic-only cell area. If a counter-free paper configuration is desired, freeze it as a new configuration and repeat VCS, DC and Formality.

p2_findings.finding: The run's input_sha256.txt records nine direct inputs but omits the nested VCS and hammer manifests/seals, docs/359 and dc_shell binary. The current wrapper checks those exact SHAs before DC, and this independent audit revalidated them, but the wrapper itself is not a frozen contract input or sealed run artifact.
p2_findings.required_action: For a future rerun, add the runner SHA and every prerequisite manifest/seal/docs/tool identity to input_sha256.txt.

required_next_gate_order: Exact-SHA Formality on frozen M474 RTL versus sealed M475 mapped netlist/SVF.
Physical feasibility and banking definition for 64x1152-bit 1R1W parent scratch and the intended resident-psum capacity.
PrimeTime with real or conservative macro timing, I/O loads and nonzero interconnect/clock envelope.
Only after all gates pass may a new independent review consider the fused cycle assumption; M473 full performance remains separately false.
